title: incident-bot + slo-toolkit: automated diagnostics, runbooks, and on-call helper CLI
author: Priya Shah
description: Motivation: reduce time-to-detect and time-to-remediate for SLO breaches by automating diagnostic collection and surfacing runbooks to on-call. This PR wires incident-bot and slo-toolkit so alerts can automatically kick off a diagnostic job, attach gathered artifacts to the incident, and present a prioritized runbook to the on-call responder. Key changes: (1) incident-bot: add diagnostics orchestration and runbook trigger endpoint; (2) slo-toolkit: new diagnostic packager, oncall-helper CLI, and standardized runbook templates; (3) ops docs: runbook and troubleshooting guides; (4) tests and CI: unit + integration test harness and a simulated alert flow. Checklist: - add diagnostic collector and uploader in incident-bot; - add oncall-helper CLI to slo-toolkit for quick artifact collection (logs, traces, recent traces, recent error samples); - add runbook templates and mapping rules for SLO alert types; - wire incident-bot to attach diagnostics artifacts to incidents and post runbook links; - add unit and integration tests; - update docs and runbook examples. Backwards compatibility: runbook templates are additive and the incident-bot endpoint defaults to disabled via feature flag. Rollout plan: feature-flagged in main, enable for SRE staging, smoke test on low-priority SLO alerts for 72h, enable progressively by team. CI notes: initial lint failure fixed in second commit; integration tests exercised with local docker-compose harness. Related: ENG-9123 tracks runbook taxonomy; SRE-204 tracks oncall-helper feature request.
